releases.notes:
- ✨ CraftGR now officially supports more than one Minecraft version at a time!
  - Latest two Minecraft releases are always supported, with an additional support for several hand-picked versions popular among the modding community.
  - As of 2.0.0, the supported versions are: **26.3, 26.2, 1.21.11 and 1.21.1**.
  - This is the first ever release to support multiple versions. All of the features from previous versions should be kept as is, but please submit bug reports if you found any bugs!
- 🐛 Fixed an issue where the radio volume slider in the Music & Sound Options menu could not be dragged around consistently

- CraftGR is now available on CurseForge as well as Modrinth
- Mod files are now separated into each mod loader again to reduce the file size and make the releases faster

- Rendering and input functions are now moved from Mixin to each mod loader's API
